C1353.title: CAC Summons Nvidia Over H20 Chip Backdoor and Vulnerability Risks
C1353.summary: On July 31, 2025, the Cyberspace Administration of China summoned Nvidia over serious security flaws exposed in its computing chips, demanding explanations and supporting evidence regarding backdoor and vulnerability risks in H20 chips sold to China. The move followed earlier disclosures by U.S. experts that Nvidia chips already possess mature tracking, positioning, and remote shutdown capabilitie
